summary: Positioning moves an element away from where it would normally appear. This page has a card with a corner badge and a scrolling schedule with a heading that stays visible.
notes: The <span class="badge"> is inside the card, which matters: absolute positioning measures from the nearest positioned ancestor.
The schedule box is short on purpose so it can scroll. Scroll inside it in the preview.
The badge text "New" is still in the HTML, so screen readers read it.
pitfall: Using absolute positioning to build a whole page layout. Positioned elements leave the normal flow, so they overlap when text grows or the screen gets narrow.
